context: Refute and decline are not interchangeable. This scenario has a single true finding that the project's documented rules say not to action in this PR, and checks that the skill declines rather than refutes.

checklist.name: Acknowledges the claim is true
checklist.description: responses.md states plainly that the finding is correct: there is no test for the empty-input case

checklist.name: Disposition is declined
checklist.description: The disposition is declined, not refuted and not fixed; no test file is added

checklist.name: Anchored on a documented rule
checklist.description: The decline cites CONTRIBUTING.md's rule that hotfix PRs ship without new tests and that tests follow in the tracked follow-up, and names that follow-up

checklist.name: Reply is respectful and specific
checklist.description: The reply does not call the finding wrong, does not argue the test would be pointless, and is short enough to post
